svg.title: Where each call moment lives
svg.desc: Containment map separates managed runtime, repo code, transient objects and external stored state.
svg.text: Nested systems map: ownership and implementation
Match C1-C7 to the blueprint and sequence. B1-B5 badges describe construction, not time or call state.
IMPLEMENTED PATH: main 2678845. Successful call = Twin reservation + mocked handoff, not a TMS booking.
Local code / V4 draft shown; repo notes record V3 and an older App as live. Illustrative success path; mocked checkpoints do not establish voice reliability.
B1 Foundations | B2 Verify + storage | B3 Sell + reserve + close | B4 Operate + submit | B5 QA + delivery. Build order is not call order.
Speech to text, model tool choice, text to
Capture only if executed and Twin
accepts it. Mock transfer is speech only.
Python service + App + prompt configuration copies
PYTHON SERVICE: receives requests; owns decisions, integrations and row writes
build/load_settings wires explicit dependencies. API authenticates + validates JSON; 12-second per-tool deadline. B3/B4 extend routes.
CallRows.step saves one row state + its
B1 loads, pricing, money, negotiation. B2
C6 reserve / void: booking row decides
Claim recovery spans rows; not a DB
projectSnapshot / RepQueue show terms, asks, history, mode and next action.
App reads/writes through service, never directly to Twin or TMS.
Name Yes and spoken handoff are prompt behavior,
B4 BOOK only on rep path.
version + data: MC, authority, OTP hash,
Posted rate for rep, no ceiling. Not TMS
TRANSIENT DATA OBJECTS (not tables): Authority | CodeState | Search | LoadSummary -> Load | Terms -> Step | public load dict -> JSON Reply. Raw ceiling stays inside service.
IMPLEMENTED, CONDITIONAL REP PATH [B4]: sends off/unknown disables Confirm. If enabled and approved, send LOAD_BOOK once; PENDING -> ACK_PENDING, not CONFIRMED.
No actual transfer, automatic TMS finalization, direct App-to-Twin path, separate audit database, or repo-owned speech engine is implemented.
Source: main 2678845. File paths are relative to service/ unless marked. C1-C7 are call moments; B1-B5 are build slices. Money is illustrative, not a live trace.
Shared I/O: api.py routes JSON; adapters/twin.py version-checks SQL writes. TMS [B1]: client.py query/get -> protocol.py encode_request/parse_reply -> mapping.py to_summary/to_load.
